verdict.rationale: Epic documents packaging and release guides for all supported platforms from one project. These cover one-click deploy to iOS and Android, and Unreal Frontend for deploying to consoles (unreal-supp-platform-targets). The cook commandlet targets multiple platforms at once (-targetplatform=<Plat1>+<Plat2>) and packages content into each platform's native format (unreal-docs-16, unreal-docs-17), and the license grants 'All platforms & features'. Missing for 10: an explicit enumerated list of desktop platforms (Windows/Mac/Linux), documentation of how console SDK and dev-kit access works, and independent hands-on corroboration of one-project multi-platform shipping.
